status: Complete independent challenge of73 remaining point notes; two new SIR restorations approved, one parallel SIR restoration corroborated,70 disclosures retained
scope: The79 point-note inventory covered by root context metadata contained six restorations already approved at dispatch. This report freshly challenges the other73. It deliberately overlaps the root review and earlier source-note reports; it is not73 new unique positions or a new whole-book review. The separate2MA14:4 consonant-restoration disclosure is outside this point-only scope.
method: Source metadata bounds were re-cropped directly from their original native images, bypassing shared scratch output names, and viewed at8x nearest-neighbor. Above-letter regions and lamed ascenders were explicitly inspected as possible holam positions. Promising cases received exact-letter15x/20x and same-word/same-page/adjacent-page comparisons. The hataf-qamats discriminator has no body occurrence on target451 or immediate450/452, so a farther same-font31:2 example on493 is explicitly identified as such. Every durable image was reproduced from a fresh PDF extraction; SIR companion halves use the established spread/side mapping. No OCR, grammar, another translation, normalization, sharpening, smoothing or synthetic pixels supplied readings. A compound point may be diagnostic despite a narrow internal bridge; holam geometry may be diagnostic despite one diagonal point-to-shoulder contact. Source form and comparisons determine the decision.
